name: Harrisburg
summary: Pennsylvania's capital on the Susquehanna — a capitol so grand Teddy Roosevelt called it the handsomest building he ever saw — and a superb Civil War museum.

lodging.name: A riverfront Harrisburg hotel
lodging.blurb: Near the capitol and the Susquehanna riverwalk.

foodMustTry.name: A Broad Street Market lunch
foodMustTry.blurb: One of the oldest continuously operating farmers' markets in the country.

days.label: Day 113 — The Capitol & the Civil War
days.summary: A palatial statehouse and a balanced war museum.

item.title: Pennsylvania State Capitol
item.blurb: A 1906 Beaux-Arts 'Palace of Art' — a 272-ft dome modeled on St. Peter's, tiled floors, and murals throughout.

item.title: National Civil War Museum
item.blurb: A rare museum that tells the war's story evenhandedly from both Union and Confederate perspectives.

days.label: Day 114 — South to Gettysburg
days.summary: A short drive to the battlefield.

commute.scenicNote: Southwest into the Adams County farmland.
